Deferred deliberately to avoid tripping RoutingConsumerTypeHealthCheck's ConstantsWithoutRows dimension on the currently-deployed spaarkedev1 BFF before the row exists (same defer-until-seedable discipline task 020 used for the memory.* rows). Owner: gate G-R2-A deploy step (task 049) or a dedicated follow-up.

fileIds.description: Optional subset of session file ids the matter proposal should be grounded in. Omit to use all session files.

practice_area.description: The matter's practice area as the user stated it in conversation (e.g. 'Employment Law', 'Litigation'), when they name one. Resolved to sprk_practicearea_ref via dataverse.read_query at write time; omitted (never guessed) if unresolvable.
practice_area.elicitation_prompt: What practice area is this matter in? (optional — I can leave this unset)

matter_type.description: The matter's type as the user stated it in conversation (e.g. 'Litigation', 'Transactional'), when they name one. Resolved to sprk_mattertype_ref via dataverse.read_query at write time; omitted (never guessed) if unresolvable.
matter_type.elicitation_prompt: What type of matter is this? (optional — I can leave this unset)
